messages:
anya: quick thought — built a small prototype called slimbridge that wraps deploy-bot for pin/unpin and adds a `rollover` command to do staged rollback + notify channels. idea: make it opt-in per release via a short manifest.

sam: ooh, can you sketch commands? :eyes:

anya: sure — basic cmds:
```
/deploy pin --manifest=release.yaml
/deploy unpin --manifest=release.yaml
/deploy rollover --to=prev --percent=20
```
rollover will: add 20% traffic to prev model group, watch errors for X mins, then continue.

chris: how's it different from current pin + canary? sounds like sugar but useful for quick half-rollbacks.

anya: exactly. reduces manual steps and creates a small audit note automatically. also supports `--dry-run` and `--notes` flags. integrates with release-notes generator so ops can click through changes.

maria: any telemetry or guardrails? don't want accidental full rollbacks.

anya: yep — safety: default `--percent=20`, requires `--confirm` to immediate 100%, and RBAC checks (only release leads or ops can escalate). also emits `release-bot` audit events.

release-bot: [audit] slimbridge: pin applied by anya on manifest release-2026-03-21, id=sb-3854321987

sam: can you add a `--brief` flag to auto-generate release-note blurb? saves copy/paste.

anya: done in prototype. it synthesizes a 1-line summary using changelog entries.

chris: thinking about templates — could ship a sample `release.yaml` that shows fields for `rollover-tolerance`, `watch-duration`, `notify-channels`.

maria: 👍 also include an example preflight check snippet for DB migrations.

anya: will push PR with README, snippets, and a tiny shim CLI. dropping link when ready.

sam: can you add a short lint in the deploy bot to warn when `pin` is used without a manifest? we see lots of stray pins.

anya: yeah, adding that to the prototype linter.

devops-bot: deploy-preview created: https://ci.internal/reviews/4567 (runs slimbridge e2e dry-run)

anya: sharing PR: https://git.internal/redwood/slimbridge/pull/12 — please review, aim for light experiment this week. if no objections I'll land and schedule a canary for Monday.

chris: quick +1 from me. :thumbsup: 

maria: +1

sam: +1

anya: thanks — will coordinate canary notes in release channel.
